Information Classification: ProtectedMCL-COM-FR-4740ND110 Sub-Contract Conditions for Lump Sum Contracts
This document is uncontrolled if printed. Please always refer to TMW for the latest versionRev 1Page {PAGENO} of {nbpg}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract Sum is a FIXED LUMP SUM price for the Subcontract Works shown, described, or inferred in the Subcontract drawings, specifications and any other documents included in this Sub-Contract Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is required to visit site in order to ascertain the quantity of materials required for the completion of the Subcontract Works and to become familiar with and allow for the site conditions and constraints.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract sum shall not be varied, other than in respect of the Contractor issuing written instructions varying the Subcontract drawings, specification, tender documents, and any other documents, in which case the Contractor will value the instruction having regard for a breakdown of the Subcontract sum to be provided by the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract sum shall include for:

children.name: text
children: a) Everything ancillary to and necessary for the proper execution of the Subcontract Works, including anything that is reasonably and obviously implied and/or inferred as necessary for the safe and satisfactory installation, execution, and operation of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: b) Obtaining approval from and the cost of compliance with any Local Authority Regulations, By-Law, Act of Parliament or Statutory Undertakers requirements with regard to the Works or with whose system the Works are or will be connected (inclusive of the costs of all connections thereto).

children.name: text
children: c) Due allowance for all work necessary to accommodate any differences between the Main Contract tolerances (as defined in the Main Contract documents) and the tolerances of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Mini Bills and/or Schedule of rates (whether or not quantified) prepared by the Contractor or the Subcontractor in connection with the tender, shall have effect only insofar as the valuing of Variations is concerned and these shall in no way be construed as amending the provisions of this Subcontract relating to Lump Sum prices.
